name: Assassin: diagnose coordinates after saved lock state

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p~=nil and p:IsTurnActive()

steps.code:
local R=ExposedMembers.JAC_Assassin; assert(R,'Assassin gameplay absent'); local t=Game:GetProperty('JAC_ASN_LIVE_TEST'); local function FixtureReveal(owner,x,y)
      local ok,why=R.TestRevealTile(owner,x,y)
      assert(ok,'fixture reveal failed: '..tostring(why))
    end; local function Grant(owner,kind,city)
      local before={}; for _,u in Players[owner]:GetUnits():Members() do before[u:GetID()]=true end
      UnitManager.InitUnitValidAdjacentHex(owner,kind,city:GetX(),city:GetY(),1)
      local found; for _,u in Players[owner]:GetUnits():Members() do
        if not before[u:GetID()] and u:GetType()==GameInfo.Units[kind].Index then found=u end
      end
      assert(found,'unit grant failed')
      if R.IsAssassin(found) then
        FixtureReveal(owner,city:GetX(),city:GetY()); FixtureReveal(owner,found:GetX(),found:GetY())
      end
      return found
    end; local function Same(a,b)
      if type(a)~=type(b) then return false end
      if type(a)~='table' then return a==b end
      for k,v in pairs(a) do if not Same(v,b[k]) then return false end end
      for k,v in pairs(b) do if not Same(v,a[k]) then return false end end
      return true
    end;  local s=R.State(t.Actor); assert(Same(s,t.LockState),'lock/state lost') assert(Same(R.Nation(t.Target),t.FreeNation),'free-city history or people lost') assert(not Players[t.Target]:IsAlive(),'load resurrected retired slot') for _,c in ipairs(t.FreeAssets) do local actual=CityManager.GetCityAt(c.X,c.Y) assert(actual and actual:GetOwner()==t.FreeNation.FreeCitiesPlayer,'load lost free city') end local ok,why=R.CanProduce(s,t.Lock-1); assert(not ok and why=='PRODUCTION_LOCK','completion+9 boundary') assert(R.CanProduce(s,t.Lock),'completion+10 boundary') assert(R.TestAdvanceDeadlines(t.Actor,{ProductionLock=true,CommandLock=true})) t.FastLock=R.Turn()+1; Game:SetProperty('JAC_ASN_LIVE_TEST',t) for _,city in ipairs(t.Cities) do local ok,why=R.StartProduction(t.Actor,city); assert(not ok and why=='PRODUCTION_LOCK','shortened lock early') end return 'saved original +9/+10 boundaries verified; shortened nationwide locks still reject before deadline'

local R=ExposedMembers.JAC_Assassin; assert(R and Game:GetProperty(R.TEST)==1); local t=Game:GetProperty('JAC_ASN_LIVE_TEST'); 
local b=t.Houses.CIVILIZATION_JAC_IMAGAWA
local city=Players[b]:GetCities():GetCapitalCity(); assert(city)
local dest=R.ResolveTarget(b,'LEADER'); assert(dest)
local x,y=city:GetX(),city:GetY()
local before={}; for _,u in Players[t.Actor]:GetUnits():Members() do before[u:GetID()]=true end
if x>=0 and y>=0 then UnitManager.InitUnitValidAdjacentHex(t.Actor,R.UNIT,x,y,1) end
local found; for _,u in Players[t.Actor]:GetUnits():Members() do
  if not before[u:GetID()] and R.IsAssassin(u) then found=u end
end
Game:SetProperty('JAC_ASN_PLACEMENT_PROBE',{Actor=t.Actor,Target=b,Unit=found and found:GetID()})
return 'city='..x..','..y..'; Gameplay destination='..dest.X..','..dest.Y..'; unit='..
  (found and (found:GetX()..','..found:GetY()) or 'not created')
